title: Google OAuth Tokens Schema
description: Schema governing sensitive Google Calendar OAuth token storage in src/data/tokens.json

access_token.description: Active short-lived bearer token for Google Calendar API calls.

refresh_token.description: Long-lived token used to automatically request fresh access tokens.

token_expiry.description: Expiration timestamp for the current access token in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last token update.

updated_by.description: Username of the administrator who last updated the token file.
